name: Umbral-Cwm
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.
Every altitude has its own weather opinion, and the hull is the only referee. Mooring in the quiet shear zones is a skill measured in survived seasons.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in fusion fuel here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
